why_this_corpus: frozen polyglot fixture tree: committed, offline, and its digest moves only on a deliberate fixture change, so a baseline stays comparable across releases. crates/codingest/src is the code under test and its digest moves nearly every release, which would make the gate REFUSE every time.
stored_value: min of 3 runs per query (repeatable inner loop); build_secs is the mean of 3 runs (once-per-build cost has no floor to find)
build_gating: recorded, not enforced: at 46 KB the build is dominated by one-time grammar init. Node/edge counts carry the build-side signal and are deterministic here (zero spread across three runs in both modes).
stability_across_3_runs: worst per-query median spread was 0.001 ms docs-on (eq_filter_pub) and 0.001 ms docs-off (defs_per_file), across three post-warmup runs per mode -- one 1 microsecond quantization tick in each mode. Node and edge counts were identical in all runs (567/880 docs-on, 560/859 docs-off) and every cross-build parity flag held. build_secs means were 0.0152 s docs-on from per-run 0.0155/0.0155/0.0145 and 0.0148 s docs-off from 0.014/0.0155/0.015. FLOORS HELD AT 0.0075 IN BOTH MODES, as 0.2.20 and 0.2.21 did: 2.5x a one-tick spread is 0.0025, which is below the instrument's own resolution-derived jitter and would tighten the gate on the luckiest round; the cost of a too-tight floor (a blocked future tag) is asymmetric against a too-loose one (still trips on the 2x this backstop exists to catch). varlen_callers_1_3 remains the control: stored at 0.029 ms docs-on / 0.03 ms docs-off, 3.87x / 4.0x the floor, well over the 2x minimum, and flat versus the 0.2.21 record (0.028/0.028, i.e. one tick) across the kglite 0.17.5 -> 0.17.6 engine move -- a move that adds graph-carried skill/recipe records codingest does not write and touches no engine query path. MACHINE STATE, recorded because this file is read across sessions: captured at load average ~3.8, after the release gate's own compare (taken at load ~13-19, PASS in both modes with the control at +3.57%/+7.14%).
